notes.title: Stones Keeper II: The Chaos Lord announcement.
notes.content:
Friends!

It is with great excitement that we announce the continuation of our fantasy turn-based strategy game, [b]Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord[/b]. The sequel offers both the well-known game mechanics from the original game and a variety of new features.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2779310/Stones_Keeper_II_Chaos_Lord/

Take a look at the trailer to find out more about the new chapter of the story before we dig into the details.

[previewyoutube=6tftU8wbwZI;full][/previewyoutube]

You probably still have questions. Below we will do our best to shed some light on to all the new features and explain them in detail.

[b]Who is the Chaos Lord?[/b]

Firstly, we want to point out that chaos is not something you have to fight, you are its very essence. Thus the Lord of Chaos is the main character, for whom you will have to lead the army of the undead. Nevertheless, not everything is so obvious, no one forbids you to do good deeds, playing the role of the real evil....

We would like to limit the amount of plot details to avoid spoilers, so that's all we can reveal at this time.

List of the most significant updates

[list]
[*] New campaign for the undead on behalf of Lord Chaos.
[*] ANIMATION OF ALL UNITS.
[*] Animation of air units (castles and pirate ships) on the global map
[*] Animation of all dialog portraits.
[*] Animation of castle scenes (store scene) and merchant scenes.
[*] Menu animation
[*] New race: Forest Spirits (with the ability to play as them in free-to-play mode).
[*] New story characters (heroes)
[*] Split characters into classes (warrior, assassin, support unit, rider, big guy).
[*] ZONE OF CONTROL
[*] UPDATED TRAINING SYSTEM (6 levels instead of 3. 3 new talent branches depending on the unit class).
[*] SPIN ATTACK (with effects on evasion and damage).
[*] NEW EQUIPMENT items (over 100 equipment items divided into three levels, unique items for each of the major factions, as well as items that affect the ability parameters of individual units or have an additional effect when used on the battlefield).
[*] Redesigned controls
[/list]

It is not a complete list, but it does cover all the major improvements.

Animations play a significant role in this list, as you can see. There have already been a few animations shown, and we're ready to present more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41089688/202fea0ce9db7ec80cbdd2d27a3ea7ee589772c3.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41089688/e8b2676f03e8815698c7b9dd1d8c4a2e49561014.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41089688/de1672f671bd743aa2685279d60e10c47cab0687.gif[/img]

[h3]A huge number of new items. This is just a small fraction of the overall amount.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41089688/a34a1f09e83310cfa66369d78e71a907c0b782c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41089688/0d384d3a6bdcbbceb8c77fab968ed0892399b056.jpg[/img]

We are steadily moving toward completion of development. The exact release date has not yet been determined.

If you have questions, everyone is always welcome on the [url=https://discord.gg/jJuCVpJY96]Discord[/url] server dedicated to the game.
Please add the game to your wishlist. It helps a lot.

See you soon!

notes.title: STONES KEEPER is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41089688/d170c9ed598a3f7c6788f0c493f744f379d1b72b.gif[/img]

Greetings, fellow adventurers!

Today we have exceptional news to share with you - STONES KEEPER is launching on Steam right NOW!
That's right, It is now time for YOU, adventurers to lead the Order of the Griffin, fight the evil, manage your castle and experience the epic tale of loyalty and betrayal in full.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1723530/Stones_Keeper/

- Over 15 hours of the main campaign
- 3 co-op maps
- Multiplayer battles
- Castle battles on the large global map
- Skirmishes Vs AI
- 4 Races (humans, elves, undead, orcs) + 4 additional races (Inquisition, Infected, Elementals, Guards)

We want to thank everyone who has supported us along the way!

Your adventure is just beginning.

notes.title: Stones Keeper: King Aurelius is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41931912/d3ea797a25c8dbfde231abb5577092d028b25c1b.gif[/img]
Greetings, fellow adventurers! The time to explore the mysterious lands and discover the fate of King Aurelius is now - we are excited to announce that [b]Stones Keeper: King Aurelius is now available on Steam![/b]

[previewyoutube=Bw17Qvfl7w0;full][/previewyoutube]

As you know, the story of King Aurelius is just the prequel to the main campaign.
Thus, the journey has only just begun, and we can't wait to show you more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1894790/Stones_Keeper_King_Aurelius/

First of all, it was thanks to our wonderful community that we received useful feedback, and as a result, the game has grown and evolved significantly. The production would not have been possible without the support and understanding of our families, partners, and friends. Thank you very much, we couldn’t have done it without you.

And finally we want to thank YOU. We appreciate everyone who stood by us and supported us during the development time. Everyone we've met in person or online at the events we have attended.

[i]We have poured our soul and heart into the game, we sincerely hope you will enjoy it![/i]

[b]So, what’s planned for the future?[/b]
 
- Releasing the full game of course!
- Making multiplayer more accessible and adding new features. We are testing the game as much as possible in order to ensure it is a better and smoother experience.

It is now time for YOU, adventurers to lead the Order of the Griffin, fight the evil, manage your castle and experience the Old King's story in full.

notes.title: STONES KEEPER: KING AURELIUS is almost here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41931912/74d4c38199d8412dfc7c7bfb3699148e08283b3f.gif[/img]

Good day to you, fellow adventurers!
It is our pleasure to inform you that STONES KEEPER: KING AURELIUS will be released very soon and you will finally be able to immerse yourself in the story of an old King. Thank you for joining us on this trip and we hope you will enjoy it as much as we do. We look forward to receiving your comments as well.

What will be available?

- King Aurelius' standalone campaign, lasting approximately two hours. Providing more lore and insight for the main game, this will tie into the events of the game.
- Free roam battles on 3 different maps
- 2 playable races: humans and undead
- 5 main units featured in the campaign mode 
- Ability to upgrade and equip your units
- Trading shop with armor, potions and weapons
- Steam achievements

Still not added to your wishlist?
Well, it's time to do it!
This will greatly help us and provide invaluable support for the project on release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1894790/Stones_Keeper_King_Aurelius/

Join to our [url=https://discord.gg/jJuCVpJY96]Discord[/url] sever and ask your questions.
